items.title: Costco rotisserie chicken
items.shortDescription: Get a Costco rotisserie chicken.

bonuses.label: Elevate it and offer it to Sagnik

items.title: Trader Joe's snack review
items.shortDescription: Review one Trader Joe's snack per team member, with at least 30 seconds of commentary each.

items.title: Bike test ride
items.shortDescription: Test ride a bike at any shop where you can buy a bike.

items.title: REI fashion show
items.shortDescription: 3+ teammates each try on a base layer, a shell and hiking pants or shorts. Take runway shots.
items.longDescription: At least 3 team members must each put on (1) a base layer, (2) a shell or outer layer and (3) hiking pants or shorts, then strut it for runway shots.

items.title: Build a box
items.shortDescription: Build a box from scratch out of any material, big enough to hold a set of keys.

items.title: Not in English
items.shortDescription: Complete a full transaction in a language that isn't English.

items.title: Ethiopian food
items.shortDescription: Order something from an Ethiopian restaurant and taste it.

items.title: Jeni's taste test
items.shortDescription: Taste test at Jeni's and film a 1-minute review video.

bonuses.label: Everyone finishes at least one scoop

items.title: Hamilton monument
items.shortDescription: Perform 1 minute of a Hamilton song at the Alexander Hamilton statue.

items.title: Broadway Playbill
items.shortDescription: Get a Broadway Playbill.

items.title: The 606
items.shortDescription: Cover at least 1 mile on the 606 and log it on Strava.

items.title: Lakefront statue
items.shortDescription: Find a sculpture or monument along the Lakefront Trail and imitate it.

items.title: Knee-deep
items.shortDescription: The full team stands knee-deep in any lake, beach or pool.

items.title: How long is your wood?
items.shortDescription: At any Home Depot, estimate a plank's length to within 2 inches, on video. Use the terminology.

items.title: Piggyback poet
items.shortDescription: In a wooded park, carry a teammate 30+ seconds while waxing poetic about the nature around you.

items.title: Colour hunt
items.shortDescription: Make a 3×3 photo grid of purple, violet or lavender things.

bonuses.label: One of the photos is a birthday cake

items.title: Flag of India
items.shortDescription: Find a flag of India.

items.title: Go Bears
items.shortDescription: Catch the Cal vs SMU game, say "Go Bears" and get someone else to say it back.

items.title: Metra balloon
items.shortDescription: Ride the Metra with a balloon for at least one stop.

bonuses.label: It's a Happy Birthday balloon and you offer it to Sagnik

items.title: Strava art
items.shortDescription: Make Strava art spelling any word of at least 4 letters.

items.title: Plane spotting
items.shortDescription: Photograph and correctly identify 3+ aircraft. No AI image search, but research is fine.

items.title: La Fournette
items.shortDescription: Get a baked good at La Fournette.

items.title: Boystown bar
items.shortDescription: At a bar in Boystown, strike up a conversation with a stranger (not the bartender).

items.title: Silent disco
items.shortDescription: Put music in your earbuds and dance like nobody's watching in front of Soundbar.

items.title: Bird spotting
items.shortDescription: Identify at least 3 birds at the Montrose Point Bird Sanctuary.

items.title: Library quote
items.shortDescription: At the Chinatown library, find a John Green book and a quote on the human condition.
items.longDescription: Find one of John Green's books at the Chinatown branch of the Chicago Public Library, then find a quote in it that comments on the human condition.

items.title: Northerly Island landing
items.shortDescription: One person is the plane, another is air traffic control. Land on the old Meigs Field airstrip.
